newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's January vehicle output rises, exports off.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's January vehicle output rises, exports off.

text.p: Mexico's vehicle production during January rose to 107,296 units versus 101,896 units produced during the same month of 1996, the Mexican Automobile Industry Association (AMIA) said in a statement.

Total vehicle sales during the month were 110,082 units, compared to sales of 100,479 units during January, 1995. Export sales during January, however, fell to 77,677 units from 80,737 units during the same month a year earlier.

Production for the domestic market in January was 24,490 units compared to 16,130 units the year before. Some 16,777 cars were produced versus 10,230 cars in Jan. 1996, while production of trucks was up 30.7 percent.

For the export market, some 82,806 units were produced during January, slightly less than the 85,766 units produced during the same month of the year before. January car production for export fell to 48,979 cars compared to 59,185 cars, while output of trucks rose to 33,827 units versus 26,581 units.
Wholesale sales in the internal market rose to 32,405 units compared to 19,742 units.
Internal retail sales during January were 29,591 units compared to 21,128 units the same month of 1996.
